basic_details.job_title: NHM Mizoram Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The National Health Mission Mizoram (NHM Mizoram) has officially announced the Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 with 8 openings on a contractual basis. The detailed notification has been published on the official website, https://nhmmizoram.org/. Candidates holding an MBBS degree from a recognized university and possessing working knowledge of the Mizo language at least up to Middle School standards are eligible to apply. Applications must be submitted via email on or before 10 August 2026. Direct links to download the official notification and application details are shared below.

how_to_apply: Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NHM Mizoram Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the NHM Mizoram Medical Officer positions is 10th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Medical Officers in NHM Mizoram?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies for the Medical Officer post announced by the National Health Mission Mizoram.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a recognized university and have a working knowledge of the Mizo language at least at the Middle School standard.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Medical Officer post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply by sending their applications via Email to the designated email address provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NHM Mizoram Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Medical Officer posts will be based on a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these Medical Officer positions?
faq.answer: The Medical Officer positions are on a contractual basis under the National Health Mission Mizoram.

faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, where a direct download link is provided.
